timeline.title: OFSS slides 3–4%; puts pile up
timeline.line: Oracle Financial Services is the weakest IT name, near ₹10,460 with heavy put buying
more: Reports put the day's fall at 3.4–4.4%; it is among the top midcap losers
6,886 contracts traded at the ₹10,500 put strike and 5,112 at ₹10,000
On Monday it fell 6.5% on an FT report of stress in loans linked to an Oracle-leased US data centre
